body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Suppress one non-Critical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn; the target may move 2 units and reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 during that time.

surges.html: Extend only the suppression through the end of your next turn.
One additional willing creature within 2 units receives the movement and Damage protection, not the Wound suppression.

rider.title: Authority - Order
rider.html: Spend this Authority when the protected creature is targeted before your next turn: it gains +1 to the targeted Defense against that attack.
